SyncComplete.description: Terminal message ending a traffic signal sync batch. Sent to the requester's reply node after the last object, or instead of any objects when the filter matched none.

syncCorrelationId.description: Copied unchanged from the SyncRequest this completes, so a requester with several syncs in flight can tell them apart.

syncId.description: The x-sync-id shared by the messages of this batch. Normally absent when no objects matched, since there was no batch to identify. Only a rejected sync is required to omit it; a success or a failed sync may carry one (a failed sync began a batch).

objectCount.description: Number of objects delivered in this batch. Zero is a valid answer and is the reason this message exists.

completedTime.description: When the publisher finished the sync.

message.description: Human-readable explanation, for rejected or failed.

SyncComplete.title: UTMC Traffic signal Sync Complete
